specs.Antenna Location: General computing, office work, and home use

features: Wireless, less clutter: 2.4GHz wireless keyboard and mouse combo to reduce cable mess on your desk.
Full-size keys, familiar feel: 104-key layout with essential keys and a dedicated ₹ key.
Quiet typing for long hours: Low-noise keys designed for everyday typing.
Compact mouse, steady control: Ergonomic shape with rubber scroll wheel and optical sensor.
Made for daily use: Keyboard supports up to 10 million keystrokes; mouse supports up to 3 million clicks.
Windows support: Works with Windows XP, 7, 8, 10, and 11 on desktops and laptops with a USB port.
